verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Cloudflare dashboard and API for creating relays and managing tokens. Nothing documents per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, or bitrate. Relay management through a dashboard and API is an adjacent capability, not session-level observability for debugging calls.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
